title: Cricket Re-Entry Block: Week 1 Movement Quality

athlete_analysis.profile_summary: 21yo recreational top-order batsman, beginner lifter, gym-trained, building lean muscle and cricket transfer. Mild right knee discomfort after long runs; Sunday match day.
primary_constraints: Mild right knee discomfort after long runs
No heavy legs the day before Sunday match
sport_demands: Front-foot control and trunk rotation for batting
Deceleration and turning for strike rotation
athlete_analysis.block_priority: Re-entry phase: movement quality, low-impact capacity, knee pain monitoring. Keep loads submaximal, progress only if 24h response is stable.

weeks.theme: Build movement quality and tolerate light loading without knee flare
weeks.progression_rule: Keep RPE 6-7. Progress next week only if knee response is stable for 24h and sessions complete.

workouts.title: Lower Strength: Knee-Friendly Squat Pattern
sport_transfer: Stable base for front-foot batting stance
workouts.why_this_session: Teaches controlled squat depth and hip stability with low knee stress while building calf capacity for fielding, keeping volume conservative in re-entry phase.

warmup.name: Lateral Leg Swing
warmup.purpose: Open frontal-plane hip range for squatting and fielding cuts

warmup.name: Bird Dog
warmup.purpose: Activate trunk and hip control before loading

main_work.name: Goblet Squat
main_work.purpose: Teach squat depth and knee tracking with front load and low joint stress

main_work.name: Landmine Squat
main_work.purpose: Guided-arc loaded squat that builds leg strength while protecting the knee

main_work.name: Standing Calf Raise
main_work.purpose: Build calf/soleus capacity to support knee and fielding push-off
coaching_notes: Use full stretch and full raise

main_work.name: Pallof Press
main_work.purpose: Anti-rotation trunk strength that transfers to batting rotation control

cooldown.name: Bird Dog
cooldown.purpose: Reinforce trunk control and downregulate after loading

injury_modifications: Limit squat depth to pain-free range on right knee
Skip any rep that causes knee discomfort
Monitor 24h knee response; regress if symptoms worsen

workouts.title: Upper Push & Scapular Health
sport_transfer: Shoulder/scapular durability for throwing and fielding
Upper-body base for bat speed control
workouts.why_this_session: Develops pressing strength and posterior shoulder capacity to keep shoulders durable for throwing, with simple beginner-friendly movements.

warmup.name: Band Pull-Apart
warmup.purpose: Activate posterior shoulder and scapula before pressing

warmup.name: Bird Dog
warmup.purpose: Trunk activation to support pressing posture

main_work.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
main_work.purpose: Build horizontal push strength with natural arm path and shoulder control
coaching_notes: Set dumbbells over elbows before first rep

main_work.name: Machine Row
main_work.purpose: Build upper-back strength with low trunk demand for posture and throwing base

main_work.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
main_work.purpose: Develop lateral deltoid for balanced shoulder hypertrophy and durability

main_work.name: Face Pull
main_work.purpose: Train scapular control and external rotation for shoulder durability in throwing

cooldown.name: Band Pull-Apart
cooldown.purpose: Light posterior shoulder endurance to finish

injury_modifications: Stop lateral raise if shoulder pinch occurs
Keep face pull pain-free in external rotation

workouts.title: Low-Impact Conditioning & Fielding Movement
sport_transfer: Ground-fielding ready position and pickup mechanics
Deceleration control for safe turning in field
workouts.why_this_session: Builds low-impact aerobic capacity and trains safe fielding deceleration without knee-aggravating long runs, matching re-entry phase goals.

warmup.name: Lateral Leg Swing
warmup.purpose: Prepare hips for lateral fielding movement

warmup.name: Bird Dog
warmup.purpose: Trunk and hip activation before movement work

main_work.name: Low-Speed Long Barrier Fielding Drill
main_work.purpose: Rehearse ground-fielding ready position, hips low and soft hands at low speed

main_work.name: Submaximal Shuttle Decelerations
main_work.purpose: Train controlled stopping and turning to build knee-safe deceleration capacity
coaching_notes: No hard cuts if knee reacts

main_work.name: Stationary Bike Aerobic Intervals
main_work.purpose: Build aerobic base with zero knee impact

main_work.name: Pallof Press
main_work.purpose: Anti-rotation trunk endurance for fielding throws and batting control

cooldown.name: Lateral Leg Swing
cooldown.purpose: Restore hip range and downregulate after movement work

injury_modifications: Avoid long continuous runs that trigger knee discomfort
Use bike instead of running if knee is reactive

workouts.title: Full-Body Strength & Rotational Trunk
sport_transfer: Trunk rotation power base for front-foot drives
Lat and back strength for bat control and throwing
workouts.why_this_session: Combines knee-friendly leg loading with back hypertrophy and light rotational work to transfer toward batting, kept off heavy legs late in the week.

warmup.name: Band Pull-Apart
warmup.purpose: Activate scapula and posterior shoulder before pulling

warmup.name: Lateral Leg Swing
warmup.purpose: Open hips before squatting and rotation

main_work.name: Goblet Squat
main_work.purpose: Reinforce squat mechanics and leg strength with low knee stress

main_work.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
main_work.purpose: Build unilateral back strength and anti-rotation trunk control for batting

main_work.name: Dumbbell Pullover
main_work.purpose: Train lat capacity through a long arc for bat-swing and throwing range

main_work.name: Landmine Rotation
main_work.purpose: Introduce controlled trunk rotation transferring to batting drive

injury_modifications: Keep squat depth pain-free on right knee
Keep pullover within comfortable overhead range
Stop rotation if any back or knee discomfort

workouts.title: Pre-Match Primer: Mobility & Activation
sport_transfer: Prime hips and trunk for Sunday batting and fielding
Keep legs fresh ahead of match day
workouts.why_this_session: Match-day-minus-1 primer: mobility, activation, and light technical rehearsal with no heavy legs or fatigue, respecting the schedule constraint and re-entry caution.

warmup.name: Lateral Leg Swing
warmup.purpose: Open hip range for fielding and batting movement

warmup.name: Band Pull-Apart
warmup.purpose: Activate posterior shoulder for throwing readiness

main_work.name: Bird Dog
main_work.purpose: Activate trunk stability without fatigue before match day

main_work.name: Shadow Batting to Target Line
main_work.purpose: Rehearse front-foot defense and drive alignment with no load

main_work.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
main_work.purpose: Light calf primer for fielding push-off without fatigue

cooldown.name: Lateral Leg Swing
cooldown.purpose: Finish with relaxed hip mobility for match-day readiness

injury_modifications: Keep all work easy and pain-free; no heavy legs before match
Skip calf primer if right knee is reactive

nutrition_focus: Vegetarian lean muscle gain: aim slight surplus, protein each meal (dairy, legumes, paneer, soy). Milk post-session aids recovery and gradual weight gain toward 78kg.
recovery_focus: Prioritize sleep toward 7.5-8h to support recovery and knee tissue
Light SMR for calves and quads, avoid excruciating pressure on knee
Monitor 24h knee response after each session
safety_notes: Re-entry phase: no max testing, sprinting, or plyometrics this week
Right knee mild discomfort: keep squats pain-free and avoid long runs
No heavy legs on Saturday before Sunday match
assumptions: No competition calendar supplied, so match-week rules stay conservative
Loads unknown for beginner, so RPE/tempo guidance is used
Cricket nets/turf available for low-speed sport drills
notes: Uses preferred days Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat
